pr.body:
## Summary
- transplant only read-only governed-delivery representation and deterministic projection payload from failed PR #1268
- remove READY and every audit/readiness/reuse/dispatch adjudication surface
- preserve canonical embedded-audit and PR Steward ownership

## Authority
Implementation starts only after a separate supervisor-authored record on current main binds this packet digest and exact execution scope.

## Safety
No Task Orchestrator mutation, GitHub mutation, audit invocation, merge, mark-ready, activation, network, database, service, daemon, or persistent cache behavior.

## Validation
L2: targeted deterministic tests, schema/runtime parity, frozen-head independent audit, canonical packet proof, and exact-head PR Steward.

steps.task: Enforce separate implementation-authority and source-custody stop gates before any payload edit.
requirements: Start from a fresh dedicated worktree at current main containing the merged authority record, never from PR #1268 or this packet-authoring worktree. Execution HEAD need not equal the authority-anchor base.

Require docs/03-reference/governance/governed-delivery/g0-lite-implementation-authority.md on current main with IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED=YES and exact bindings for packet ID, packet SHA-256, AUTHORITY_ANCHOR_BASE_SHA, EXECUTION_START_POLICY, allowlist, runner/agent ceiling, and stop conditions.

Require AUTHORITY_ANCHOR_BASE_SHA to be an ancestor of execution-start main. Classify every intervening change as authority-publication-only or prove it compatible and non-overlapping with the seventeen-path G0-Lite payload; CONFLICTING or UNKNOWN stops.
Treat PR #1268 and caa4ec2913d0463c7e38835029f3f7adeb915ac6 as read-only evidence. Do not mutate, merge, close, mark ready, rebase, rewrite, or continue repair there.

Fetch refs/pull/1268/head into the bounded local ref refs/dopemux/custody/pr-1268-caa4ec2913d0463c7e38835029f3f7adeb915ac6 without force, then require that ref^{commit} to resolve exactly to caa4ec2913d0463c7e38835029f3f7adeb915ac6 before reading any failed-PR source path.

Define the planned G0-Lite payload as exactly the seventeen non-packet, non-proof paths in commit.allowlist. Require exactly one merge base between execution-main HEAD and the verified custody ref. Derive MAIN_PATHS from merge-base..HEAD and SOURCE_PATHS from merge-base..custody-ref using those exact pathspecs and --no-renames; derive SHARED_PATHS as their intersection.

Classify overlap deterministically: COMPATIBLE when SHARED_PATHS is empty; otherwise CONFLICTING when any shared path has a different final path state between HEAD and the custody ref; otherwise IDENTICAL when MAIN_PATHS equals SOURCE_PATHS, SUBSET when MAIN_PATHS is a proper subset of SOURCE_PATHS, SUPERSET when MAIN_PATHS is a proper superset of SOURCE_PATHS, and COMPATIBLE for all other equal-shared-state set relations. SUBSET and SUPERSET are always recorded from the execution-main perspective.

Any missing authority, fetch failure, exact-SHA mismatch, absent or multiple merge base, path-enumeration failure, path outside the planned payload, or unprovable shared-path state is UNKNOWN. CONFLICTING or UNKNOWN stops for supervisor review.
